reference_basis: Published field steel-tape centre spacings, ordered on the asymmetric stepped wingwall plot, NOT design dimensions or author algorithm outputs

anchor_evidence.orientation: Unique stepped/sloping outline in source MAT and report Fig.14; report frame X=source_max_Y-source_Y, Y=source_X. No reflection/orientation search against tape values.
anchor_evidence.x_labels: Source annotated photo 1-5.png supplies physical RB1-RB5 labels at the low/sloping end; Fig.14 orders remaining columns continuously to flat high end.
anchor_evidence.y_labels: Source annotated photo A-C.png supplies physical RB-A/RB-B/RB-C at the lower edge; Fig.14 orders remaining rows upward.

source_notes: Table5 third X row prints (3-6), a label typo resolved by Fig14 showing the third adjacent interval and source RB3/RB4 labels.
Fig14 gives top Y tape 5.75 inches; Table5 rounds it to 5.8. Use the finer published Fig14 value consistently.
Most tape values are published at 0.1 inch resolution (2.54 mm); no sub-mm accuracy or metrological calibration is implied.
MAT is the source authors CSV-exported XYZ, as documented in densityByLayer_example.m. Metre convention follows companion GeoSLAM E57; no independent scale calibration is claimed.
identity_window_basis: Manual scan-side bar identity regions viewed in original XYZ and asymmetric source diagram. Used only after detection to reject wrong identities; NOT metric spacing truth or detector priors.
